px_scale_note: texture px x px_scale = design px

layers.note: authored 1280 x 260; stretch to the pad-strip rectangle

passage_frame.note: hospital door arch, centre pivot, 640 x 360 design px: scale 2x to span the 1280 x 720 frame; the arched opening (300 wide, apex y 36) is transparent

waking_view.note: what the opening eyes see: the family leaning in over the bed, warm and almost in focus (full screen, centre pivot)

waking_blur.note: the same, completely out of focus (the first moment)

eyelid_top.note: the upper lid, 1280 x 520 design px; pivot = bottom centre = the closing edge (put it at the eye line y 360 when shut, slide it up to open)

eyelid_bottom.note: the lower lid, 1280 x 520 design px; pivot = top centre (the edge that meets the upper lid at y 360); slide it down to open

monitor_line.note: a 1024 px heartbeat trace repeating every 330 px; scroll or reveal it left to right; tint it green-white
